description: If the workspace has no funding, offer the complimentary Visibility Check first (socialseal_start_visibility_check). When this action returns reason funding_required with suggestedTool, it did not run: relay its text, collect what missing lists, and once the user agrees call that tool with suggestedArguments plus brand as locator, market as market and the business's own website as targetWebsiteUrl. Start a bounded video search for a query, platform and region. Subscription workspaces pay credits; prepaid workspaces pay the returned USD price only when the search completes with results. Returns jobId when admitted, or a saved operationId with status funding_required when the balance is short: when that result carries suggestedTool, relay its text and offer the free check; otherwise, after a top-up, send the same request again with the same idempotency key; never replace the pending request. Poll socialseal_get_video_search for admitted legacy jobs. Concurrent equivalent searches coalesce. No ongoing tracker is created. Preserve returned coverage and provider limitations. Search rows describe videos surfaced for selected queries at capture time, not search volume or total market demand. Within one platform, market and capture window, result counts, rank and views remain valid relative demand signals for comparing queries; when asked to prioritise, rank with them and label confidence instead of declining. Region is the collection market, not verified viewer geography. Views/likes/saves are video engagement snapshots, not engagement attributable to that query or gains during the export window. State query/platform/market/date scope and coverage; deduplicate videos before aggregating across queries. Define rate denominators and preserve missing values as unknown. Inspect relevant video evidence before recommending a creative treatment.

idempotencyKey.description: Generate once per intended search and reuse for retries. Use a new key to refresh results later.

limit.description: Fresh-result limit: TikTok 20, Instagram 30, YouTube/Douyin/XHS 50. Default 20. The price uses this requested scope.

maxCostUsd.description: Optional USD maximum for this search; a higher price is refused with CALLER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

quoteOnly.description: Return the price without starting provider work: credits for subscription workspaces, USD for prepaid.

region.description: Search collection market; does not establish viewer residence or audience demographics.

strategyRevisionId.description: revisionId of a brand Strategy already returned in this conversation (strategyContext.revisionId). When it is still current, the Strategy is not repeated.

workspaceId.description: Authorized workspace for this search; resolve it before starting.
